data.narrative:
Oxford Nanopore Technologies is a public-stage biotech company in the Biotech & Health sector that has raised over $1B to date. This valuation analysis draws on a peer set of four same-sector, same-stage comparables: Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M).

The peer-median method is the sole applicable triangulation approach here, given the absence of disclosed revenue figures required for public-comp anchoring. The median valuation across the four-company peer set is $1.1B, with a range spanning $539M to $1.6B. This peer-median anchoring directly reflects recent market pricing for similarly-staged biotech entities and provides a market-grounded benchmark. The range captures valuation variance within the cohort but reflects established public market pricing rather than speculative forward multiples.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $910M to $1.2B, centered on $1.1B. Key limitations include reliance on a single applicable method; ideally, revenue-based multiples or discounted cash flow analysis would provide additional triangulation points, but such data is unavailable. The peer set itself—though carefully filtered for sector and stage alignment—remains modest in size. Valuation sensitivity hinges on relative positioning within the peer range and any material divergence in clinical or commercial pipeline strength versus the median comparables.
